test_title: PYST 23 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 20 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Change the following sentence into the Active form.**

It was understood that a new management team had been appointed.

options.text: A new management team had been appointed, it was understood.
They understood that a new management team had been appointed.
It was understood that they appointed a new management team.
A new management team was appointed, as they understood.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Passive voice structure: The subject of the active voice sentence performs the action.
 
• In the passive voice, the original sentence is: "It was understood that a new management team had been appointed."
 
• To convert to active voice: Identify the implied subject, which is "they."
 
• Place "they" at the beginning of the sentence.<
